title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Academic Speaking Test 3 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: Did you enjoy going to museums when you were a child?
Are there any interesting museums near where you live now?
Do you think it is best to go to museums by yourself or with friends?
When you visit another city or country, do you think it's important to go to a museum there?

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a piece of work you did for your job or your studies that you felt very satisfied with.
cue_card_bullets: what this piece of work was
why you did this piece of work
who or what helped you to do this work
and explain why you felt so satisfied with this piece of work

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: What are some aspects of people's lives that they can often be dissatisfied with?
Would you say that having ambitions in life is always a positive thing?
What do you believe the most important components are of a satisfying life?
What makes a job more satisfying: a high salary or having good colleagues?
Do you think people need to change jobs regularly if they want to stay satisfied at work?
Is it possible to find job satisfaction in all types of work?
